modelOverview: Introduced in 2018, the Aquanaut Chronograph ref. 5968A was the first chronograph to join the Aquanaut family, pairing the model's signature 42.2mm octagonal steel case and embossed dial with a self-winding flyback chronograph movement. Nicknamed the "Orange" for its vivid orange chronograph accents and strap, it quickly became one of the most sought-after modern steel sports chronographs from the manufacture.

5968A-001.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre CH 28-520 C · flyback chronograph, vertical clutch, column wheel · 45–55h power reserve
5968A-001.materials: Stainless steel case, supplied with a black and an orange composite (Tropical rubber) strap on a steel fold-over clasp with four independent catches
5968A-001.bezel: Steel octagonal bezel with contrasting polished and satin finishes, no visible screws
5968A-001.dial: Sunburst charcoal-grey/black dial with black-gradient rim, embossed Aquanaut pattern, white-gold applied numerals and luminescent baton hands, orange chronograph accents, central chronograph hand, 60-minute counter at 6 o'clock and date window at 3 o'clock
5968A-001.description: The 5968A-001 "Orange" is the steel Aquanaut Chronograph that introduced the flyback complication to the Aquanaut line, running the self-winding Calibre CH 28-520 C beneath a sapphire caseback. It is distinguished by its charcoal-black embossed dial with bright orange chronograph accents and comes supplied with both black and orange Tropical composite straps. Each example offered is sourced and fully authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Orange: 5968A-001 in stainless steel with the sunburst charcoal-black embossed dial and orange chronograph accents, supplied with both a black and an orange Tropical composite strap, the standard-bearer configuration for the Aquanaut Chronograph.
